title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 7: Diagnosis

scenes.say: Back stateside, he feels tired. Not regular tired. Bone tired.
scenes.visual: a soldier sitting on the edge of a bed in a dim barracks room, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He ignores it. Soldiers ignore everything.
scenes.visual: boots being laced in early morning, slow and heavy, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Then the doctor closes the door before she talks.
scenes.visual: a closed hospital exam room door, soft clinical light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: One word changes the whole room. Cancer.
scenes.visual: an empty hospital chair beside a window, sterile white light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He survived bullets and bombs. Now the war is inside him.
scenes.visual: an x-ray lightbox glowing in a dark room, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He calls his mother. He can't get the word out.
scenes.visual: a phone held in a shaking hand in a hospital hallway, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: She doesn't cry on the phone. She waits until he hangs up.
scenes.visual: a woman sitting alone on a staircase, hand over her mouth, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Treatment strips him down further than boot camp ever did.
scenes.visual: an IV drip bag hanging beside a hospital bed, morning light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Some days he can't lift his head. Some days he can't lift his faith.
scenes.visual: a man lying in a hospital bed facing the window, rain outside, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: But he remembers Roddy's seat. He's still here for a reason.
scenes.visual: a pair of dog tags resting on a hospital tray table, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Eight. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: sunlight breaking through hospital blinds, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 7 of 25: Diagnosis. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
